real_use_case: Verify artifact manifest shape, exact SHA-256 content identity, and exact byte size before downstream model construction.
upstream_status: Project-owned deterministic gate over ArtifactManifest v1.0.0.
license: Project-owned implementation; no third-party runtime or resource.
supported_profile: ArtifactManifest v1.0.0 mapping plus exact artifact bytes.
resource_budget: O(n) time for SHA-256 and O(1) auxiliary state beyond the supplied input bytes.
known_issues: Does not trust filenames, promote artifacts, attest caches, resolve reference identity, or interpret scientific content.
security: Pure mapping and bytes processing with no filesystem, network, subprocess, or dynamic code execution.
disable_path: Not wired to any default execution pipeline.
